titolo: Google launches Gemini 4 Hydrogen for coding, agentic workflows and Search
descr: Gemini 4 Hydrogen offers fast, efficient AI for developers and powers a visual upgrade to Google Search worldwide.
paragrafi: Google DeepMind announced Gemini 4 Hydrogen on 12 November 2026 as a model aimed at rapid execution in everyday coding and agentic workflows.
The model pairs with frontier models Gemini 4 Carbon and Argon via the new Orchestrator, delivering 24% less quota use and 19% faster completion on Terminal‑Bench 4.0.
Hydrogen ranks #5 on Agent Arena, leads its class on HLE‑Diamond (58.8%), tops Vals Tax Agent Bench (52.3%) and ties for first on Vals Legal Research Bench (55.8%).
Google Search globally integrates Hydrogen, adding more visual, structured answers, better intent understanding and simultaneous query fan‑out.
The upgrade is available to all Search users, with no additional subscription required.
perche: Hydrogen gives developers a faster, lower‑cost alternative to Carbon for routine coding tasks while still supporting multi‑model pipelines.
